blurb: Guests visit the Santa Barbara Zoo to see and learn about animals, participate in wildlife experiences, enjoy train rides, and attend special events like Boo at the Zoo. The Zoo offers educational field trips, birthday party packages, and memberships with various benefits. Accessibility services and sensory backpacks are available to enhance the visit experience.
extraNote: For every five students, one adult chaperone ticket is free for field trips · Adults must purchase Group Adult Ticket for $19.95 when school not in session · Early field trip reservations recommended; limited groups admitted daily · $500 deposit required to confirm birthday party reservation; non-refundable · Birthday party deposit transferable with $250 fee if less than 10 days before party · Birthday party deposit forfeited if cancellation less than 72 hours before party · Boo at the Zoo tickets are non-refundable but may be exchanged for another date · Zoo parking $11 per vehicle; free for members during regular hours
